bookkeeping.rowText: With `LEDGER_PROXY_SECRET` bound every beacon shape costs the edge ZERO KV writes (up to fifteen before, thirteen on a fresh-nonce replay; unbound, the replay now costs one); the rate limiters and the connect door use the ledger's atomic increment with a KV fallback declared in `X-Ledger-Fallback`, and a failing store answers 429 instead of throwing; ledger routes for telemetry, increment, bug reports and prize codes with the same allowlists and caps, a 90-day `expires_at` swept daily at 02:00 UTC; `scripts/kv-to-ledger-migrate.mjs` written, NOT run; the two split bindings written in the report, not applied. Gates: accounts 241, mp 528, stats unchanged, guards 22/22. NOTHING IS LIVE until the ops evening binds the secret (`docs/ops/ops-evening-2026-09.md` Part C, eight steps, with two owner decisions there: F-KV1-7 bug reports and hashed IPs entering the backups and the archive; F-KV1-3 the demotion count). Slices left: F-KV1-4 (the multiplayer fallback's own limiter), F-KV1-5 (the Pages standings copy still writes KV). Engine hash unchanged {PIN}; no deploy (the edge functions deploy with the next production deploy and stay inert unbound).
